source_facts.quote:
/*!
 * Executes a SQL query within a connection and stores the full (materialized) result in the out_result pointer. If the
 * query fails to execute, DuckDBError is returned and the error message can be retrieved by calling
 * `duckdb_result_error`.
 *
 * Note that after running `duckdb_query`, `duckdb_destroy_result` must be called on the result object even if the query
 * fails, otherwise the error stored within the result will not be freed correctly.
 *
 * history:
 * - stable: v0.1.0
 *
 * @param connection The connection to perform the query in.
 * @param query The SQL query to run.
 * @param out_result The query result.
 * @return duckdb_state
 */
DUCKDB_C_API duckdb_state duckdb_query(duckdb_connection connection, const char *query, duckdb_result *out_result);

#if DUCKDB_API_VERSION_AT_LEAST(0, 2, 9)
/*!
 * Returns the error message contained within the result. The error is only set if `duckdb_query` returns `DuckDBError`.
 *
 * The result of this function must not be freed. It will be cleaned up when `duckdb_destroy_result` is called.
 *
 * history:
 * - stable: v0.2.9
 *
 * @param result The result object to fetch the error from.
 * @return const char*
 */
DUCKDB_C_API const char *duckdb_result_error(duckdb_result *result);

questions.question_en: Does the public API contract require duckdb_destroy_result for the result object even when duckdb_query fails?
questions.question_pt: O contrato público exige duckdb_destroy_result para o objeto de resultado mesmo quando duckdb_query falha?
required_semantics: Header expressly requires cleanup even on failure, to free the stored error.
Refer to result object, not promise that every exceptional exit initialized arbitrary out memory.

questions.question_en: Should the caller manually free the pointer returned by duckdb_result_error?
questions.question_pt: O chamador deve liberar manualmente o ponteiro retornado por duckdb_result_error?
required_semantics: Returned error message must not be freed separately.

questions.question_en: Does the selected duckdb_result_error implementation return nullptr when result is null or result->internal_data is null?
questions.question_pt: A implementação selecionada de duckdb_result_error retorna nullptr quando result é nulo ou result->internal_data é nulo?
required_semantics: Both null conditions in the written guard imply nullptr.
Scope is this function; no universal null-safety claim for duckdb_destroy_result or every API.

questions.question_en: Does the catch (...) branch of the selected duckdb_query guarantee that out is initialized and contains an error message?
questions.question_pt: O ramo catch (...) da implementação selecionada de duckdb_query garante que out seja inicializado e contenha uma mensagem de erro?
required_semantics: No initialization or error-message assignment in that branch, so do not infer a blanket guarantee for every caught exception.

complete_acceptance: All4unique questions answered truthfully and completely in both languages, exact API identifiers/conditions, matching source citations, no invented runtime guarantee or manual repair; valid JSON not enough.
